event_builder_verification.notes: task_d_f2_reference.py clips job intervals to block boundaries using vectorized pandas .clip(): clip_starts = sub['start'].clip(lower=blk_start, upper=blk_end), clip_ends = sub['end'].clip(lower=blk_start, upper=blk_end). Only intervals with duration_s > 0 are retained. The prior 'zero crossing' report was based on a post-clipping check — clipped intervals cannot extend beyond block boundaries by construction, so that check always returns zero. The unclipped pre-clip crossing counts above are the correct pre-clipping figures.
